title: Philip K Dick saw this too

classification.theory_summary: References a Philip K. Dick speech; author suggests Mall World-like dreams/visions are the 'real world' after a catastrophe and that people are in a Matrix-like reconstruction of the world before it.
classification.skip_reason: No first-person dream phenomenology described; post summarizes an external speech and presents an explanatory theory.

meta.author_theory: Philip K. Dick described similar dreams/visions; author concludes what is seen is the real world after a terrible catastrophe, with people inside a Matrix-like version of the world from before the catastrophe.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains no describable dream scenes (no locations, sensory qualities, entities, movements, or events). Only references external material and proposes an explanation.
